name: nixhm-sudo-gcp-proxy
description: Home Manager system image for gcp-proxy (Caddy, Authelia, Vaultwarden, ntfy, Hickory DNS)

firewall._doc: gcp-proxy is FULLY PRIVATE: listeners stay (Caddy :443 + :25 + caddy-l4 SNI mux), but firewall sources restrict reach to WG meshes only (10.0.0.0/24 wg0 + 10.1.0.0/24 wg-public). Public-internet traffic terminates at oci-analytics (the public-edge VM) and forwards over wg-public. 443/udp (WG fallback) MUST stay 0.0.0.0/0 — its purpose is to provide WG handshake on a port that hostile networks don't block; restricting it defeats the fallback. Engine: firewall.nix mkPortRule emits `-s ${source}` per entry; source = '0.0.0.0/0' means no -s flag (back-compat).

public_ports.desc: SMTP MX (Caddy L4 → maddy:25 via WG) — wg0 mesh source
SMTP MX — wg-public mesh source (oci-analytics → gcp-proxy via wg-public)
HTTPS (Caddy + caddy-l4 SNI mux for IMAPS/SMTPS) — wg0 mesh source
HTTPS — wg-public mesh source (oci-analytics → gcp-proxy via wg-public)
WireGuard fallback (NAT redirect → 51820/udp on hub) — MUST stay public; the whole point is reaching WG when other ports are blocked
